prompt: In a vast, silent library at night, a young male librarian is standing on a rolling ladder, reaching for a book on a very high shelf. A ghostly, translucent female figure is floating in the aisle behind him, pointing a finger at a different, glowing book on a lower shelf. The bookshelf is much taller than the librarian, even when he is on the ladder. The librarian is looking up at the book he is reaching for. The ghostly figure is facing the librarian's back. On a reading table next to the ladder, there are two chairs and a stack of books. The number of books in the stack is three times the number of chairs. An open book, separate from the stack, is lying beside it. The glowing book is the brightest object in the scene. The ghost is floating between the librarian and the reading table.
